en_title: The Elder Scrolls Online Content Delayed to 2027 Following Xbox Layoffs
cn_title: XBOX裁员后《上古卷轴Online》新内容延期至2027年
subtitle: 不会停服
opus_summary: 受XBOX重组及裁员影响，《上古卷轴Online》的Crimson Veldt试炼、职业与战斗系统翻新及52号更新推迟至2027年。游戏总监强调团队仍会继续运营游戏，2026年秋季仍将推出故事、任务、活动和多项系统改进。

paragraphs.en: The Elder Scrolls Online is undergoing some setbacks as a result of Xbox's recent reset and associated layoffs.
paragraphs.cn: 受XBOX近期重组及相关裁员影响，《上古卷轴Online》正遭遇一些挫折。

paragraphs.en: There has been a lot of speculation over the future of ESO for about a month now, and the team behind the game has stepped forward to clear the air. In a new blog post from game director Nick Giacomini, it is made clear that Elder Scrolls Online will continue and isn't on the verge of being shut down.
paragraphs.cn: 约一个月来，外界一直对ESO的未来多有猜测，游戏团队现已出面澄清。游戏总监Nick Giacomini在一篇新博文中明确表示，《上古卷轴Online》会继续运营，并未濒临停服。

paragraphs.en: "Recently, we've been through a number of organizational changes and departures of teammates who helped shape The Elder Scrolls Online," he wrote. "We are profoundly grateful for everything they've contributed to the game and the community we've built together.
paragraphs.cn: 他写道：「最近，我们经历了多项组织调整，也有一些曾参与塑造《上古卷轴Online》的团队成员离开。我们由衷感谢他们为这款游戏，以及我们共同建立的社区所做的一切贡献。」

paragraphs.en: "At the same time, we've seen a lot of questions about what these changes mean for ESO. So let me be clear: ESO is here to stay, and our team is dedicated to the future of this game. Our focus hasn't changed. It is continuing to grow The Elder Scrolls Online and build upon the world millions of players call home."
paragraphs.cn: 「与此同时，我们也看到许多人询问这些变化对ESO意味着什么。因此请允许我明确说明：ESO会继续存在，我们的团队致力于这款游戏的未来。我们的重点没有改变，那就是继续发展《上古卷轴Online》，并扩展数百万玩家视为家园的这个世界。」

paragraphs.en: Giacomini also outlined the team's plans to support the game going forward. He reaffirmed the recent news that ZeniMax Online Studios will be closely collaborating with Bethesda Game Studios on the future of The Elder Scrolls and stated that will give the team "new opportunities to share ideas" and create better experiences for players.
paragraphs.cn: Giacomini还概述了团队今后支持这款游戏的计划。他重申了近期消息：ZeniMax Online Studios将与Bethesda Game Studios紧密合作，共同规划《上古卷轴》的未来；他表示，这将为团队带来「交流想法的新机会」，并为玩家打造更好的体验。

paragraphs.en: Unfortunately, the team is also delaying some content. Due to the recent restructuring at all Xbox-owned studios, the team has had to delay content in order to make sure it meets a level of quality that everyone can be satisfied with. So, the new Crimson Veldt trial, class and combat refreshes, and update 52 are all being pushed back to 2027.
paragraphs.cn: 遗憾的是，团队也将推迟部分内容。由于近期所有XBOX旗下工作室都在重组，团队不得不延期，以确保内容达到所有人都能满意的质量水平。因此，新的Crimson Veldt试炼、职业与战斗系统翻新，以及52号更新都将推迟至2027年。

paragraphs.en: "Instead of rushing to hit a previously announced deadline, we are giving our teams the runway they need to do things right," said the game director. "Some of our upcoming additions, like the Class and Combat Refresh and our new Trial, are highly complex, and we want to ensure they hit the mark before we put them in your hands."
paragraphs.cn: 游戏总监表示：「与其仓促赶上此前公布的期限，我们选择给团队留出把事情做好的必要空间。我们即将推出的一些内容，例如职业与战斗系统翻新以及新试炼，都非常复杂；我们希望在交到玩家手中前，确保它们达标。」

paragraphs.en: There will still be plenty of content coming to Elder Scrolls Online in 2026, though. New stories, quests, and events are coming throughout the fall in addition to a new rumor system and quality of life upgrades. These pieces of content will roll out across September and October as part of Season 1 and Season 2.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，2026年《上古卷轴Online》仍会迎来大量内容。整个秋季将推出新故事、任务和活动，以及新的传闻系统和体验优化。这些内容将作为第1季和第2季的一部分，在9月和10月陆续上线。

paragraphs.en: As already noted, ZOS is also working closely with Bethesda Game Studio on the future of the IP. It's believed the studio will be assisting on the development of The Elder Scrolls 6 , arguably the most important game that Xbox has on the horizon. The stakes are pretty high given the state of Xbox and the fact Starfield failed to meet expectations for many players. Bethesda will likely need all the help it can get to give something that justifies the long wait for this game.
paragraphs.cn: 如前所述，ZOS也正与Bethesda Game Studio紧密合作，规划这一IP的未来。外界认为，该工作室将协助开发《上古卷轴6》——这或许是XBOX目前最重要的待发售游戏。考虑到XBOX的现状，以及《星空》未能满足许多玩家期待这一事实，风险相当高。贝塞斯达可能需要尽可能多的帮助，才能交出一款配得上玩家漫长等待的作品。

paragraphs.en: Bethesda is also continuing to support its other big IP, Fallout. Remasters of Fallout 3 and New Vegas are in the works in addition to a new Fallout game from Obsidian Entertainment. Bethesda has also entered pre-production on Fallout 5 , likely to ensure the team can make the jump to it after The Elder Scrolls 6 is finished.
paragraphs.cn: 贝塞斯达也在继续支持旗下另一大IP《辐射》。除《辐射3》和《辐射：新维加斯》的重制版正在开发外，黑曜石还在制作一款新的《辐射》游戏。贝塞斯达也已开始《辐射5》的前期制作，可能是为了确保团队在完成《上古卷轴6》后能够转入该项目。
